title: CIC: A Framework for Culturally-Aware Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating image captioning models on images from four distinct cultural groups (West, East Asia, South Asia, and Africa) using human evaluation (user surveys assessing the quality of cultural descriptions and matching of cultural categories) and automatic metrics (CLIPScore and a newly introduced Culture Noise Rate (CNR) metric that calculates the ratio of cultural words based on cultural commonsense knowledge).
